CustomField.description: Stores the User record of the Sales Development Representative (SDR) associated to the Opportunity via the Opportunity Contact Role where Role = “Sales Development Representative”. This field is used to enable reporting, filtering, and searchability (e.g. in Clari Inspect) for SDR contribution where the SDR is not the Opportunity Owner.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Auto-populated from the Opportunity Contact Role where Role = “Sales Development Representative”. Used for visibility and reporting of SDR involvement. Do not manually edit.
CustomField.label: Sales Development Representative
